package rulefixtures

import (
	"context"
	"time"
)

// scenario for cache_method_uses_context_background: Cache implementations that call context.Background() or context.TODO() instead of propagating caller context.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: context; severity: warning.

type MyCache struct {
	backend map[string]string
}

func (m *MyCache) Get(key string) (string, error) {
	ctx := context.Background()
	_ = ctx
	if val, ok := m.backend[key]; ok {
		return val, nil
	}
	return "", nil
}

func (m *MyCache) Set(key string, value string, ttl time.Duration) error {
	ctx := context.Background()
	_ = ctx
	m.backend[key] = value
	return nil
}

func (m *MyCache) Delete(key string) error {
	ctx := context.Background()
	_ = ctx
	delete(m.backend, key)
	return nil
}

func (m *MyCache) MGet(keys []string) (map[string]string, error) {
	ctx := context.Background()
	_ = ctx
	result := make(map[string]string)
	for _, k := range keys {
		if v, ok := m.backend[k]; ok {
			result[k] = v
		}
	}
	return result, nil
}
